sources.games: 667 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.5%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py drow_ranger.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Silver Edge, Hurricane Pike, Linken's Sphere, Aghanim's Scepter.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Drow Ranger players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 52% of 60 games against them (25% otherwise), won 71% against 48%. Shadow Blade (invis_sword) is in her build at ~27 min.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 88% (-2), wraith_band 22% (2), power_treads 100% (6), falcon_blade 84% (7), yasha 88% (14), dragon_lance 98% (14), manta 75% (20), ultimate_scepter 41% (20), force_staff 85% (22), hurricane_pike 85% (22), invis_sword 36% (27), black_king_bar 45% (29), silver_edge 32% (30), butterfly 46% (32), aghanims_shard 48% (33), lesser_crit 30% (34), greater_crit 21% (38), satanic 22% (41).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 13000 (16 games, 93.8%), 25:00 16000 (74 games, 87.8%), 30:00 20500 (65 games, 86.2%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Valve 7.41f Multishot: 3 waves of 4 arrows in a 50° cone, each applying Frost Arrows, so the illusions in front of her are hit together. High-rank Drow Ranger players do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (62 games: it is not among the items they buy more often there).

skills.basis: 667 games: maxed drow_ranger_multishot > drow_ranger_frost_arrows > drow_ranger_wave_of_silence 547 (win 50.5%), drow_ranger_multishot > drow_ranger_frost_arrows 61 (win 44.3%), drow_ranger_frost_arrows > drow_ranger_multishot > drow_ranger_wave_of_silence 46 (win 50.0%); talents 10: +1 Multishot Arrow Per Wave 549/667 (50.6%), -18% Frost Arrows Mana Cost 118/667 (44.1%); 15: -6s Multishot Cooldown 462/634 (52.4%), +75 Attack Range 172/634 (47.7%); 20: 50% Gust Self Movement Speed 252/455 (53.2%), +25% Multishot Damage 203/455 (62.1%); 25: +1 Multishot Wave 94/183 (60.6%), +8% Marksmanship Chance 89/183 (61.8%).
